summary: WiMi Hologram Cloud Inc., a Beijing-based prepackaged software company listed on Nasdaq (File 001-39257), furnished a Form 6-K, the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report, covering the period ended June 30, 2026 and filed September 17, 2026. The submission consists of routine interim financial statements and XBRL exhibits, including segment revenue splits for Hong Kong and Mainland PRC, supplier concentration disclosures, warrant fair-value inputs in CNY and USD, and dual-class A/B share detail. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. No special-situation or risk-arb angle arises.
